Mern Internship 
Developed a backend automation system using Node.js and Express that streamlined end-to-end request workflows, from user submission to managerial 
approval, with efficient tracking and optimized API-driven processes integrated with MongoDB. 
SKILLS ACQUIRED 
 Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript (ES6+), React.js, React Native, TailwindCSS. 
 Backend: Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, MySQL 
 Version Control & Collaboration: Git, GitHub. 
 Testing & Tools: Postman, Jest, Mocha. 
 
1.Alarm Clock App (Django , MongoDB) 
 I developed a full-stack alarm clock web application using Django for backend logic and MongoDB for flexible data storage. The app features user 
authentication, allowing individuals to securely manage their alarms. I implemented alarm scheduling with asynchronous task handling to ensure accurate 
time-based triggers and real-time notifications. The frontend offers an intuitive interface for setting, editing, and deleting alarms, complete with customizable 
tones and repeat options. This project demonstrates my ability to integrate backend services with responsive UI design and time-sensitive functionality. 
 2025 
2.Online Quiz and Leaderboard Platform 
I Developed an interactive Online Quiz and Leaderboard Platform enabling real-time assessments and competitive engagement. Integrated dynamic question 
sets, timed sessions, and instant scoring to enhance user experience. Implemented secure login, role-based access, and responsive UI for seamless participation. 
Leaderboard system tracks performance and promotes healthy competition. Designed for scalability and analytics to support educational and corporate training 
environments.Supply Chain Tracking System. 
 2025 
3.Online Notice Board System 
I developed a centralized Online Notice Board Platform designed to simplify communication and information sharing across institutions. The system 
enables administrators to post, update, and categorize notices in real time, ensuring instant visibility for users. Integrated secure login and role-based 
access to differentiate between administrators, faculty, and students. Designed a responsive UI for seamless access across devices, with search and filter 
options for quick retrieval of notices. Implemented notification features to alert users of new updates, enhancing engagement and reducing communication 
gaps. Built with scalability and analytics in mind to support educational, corporate, and community environments.
